publication_policy.purpose: Independent editorial artist discovery; display advertising possible
publication_policy.editorial_photo_usage: No implied endorsement, artist affiliation, merchandise promotion, or image advertising. Respect country-specific personality/publicity rights.
publication_policy.attribution: Place photographer/source/license near each image or link from each image to a clearly discoverable, complete Media Credits page. Indicate any changes/cropping.
publication_policy.share_alike: When modifying a CC BY-SA photo, license the adapted IMAGE under the same/compatible CC BY-SA version, and preserve full credit; this does not make the whole website CC BY-SA.
publication_policy.source_handling: Download only approved Commons photo files to WordPress Media Library. Do not hotlink to Wikimedia for production.
publication_policy.album_artwork: No standalone cover-image downloads. Render through Spotify official embed; link to song when embeds unavailable.
publication_policy.rights_disclaimer: Commons licences are uploader-provided declarations and do not eliminate third-party or personality rights; recheck status before launch.
